title: Sparkling Water 12-pack

drivers.name: 25% off promotion (deeper than prior)
drivers.evidence: Deeper discount than prior 20% and 10% off; past 20% off at holiday lifted x3.5, but recent 20% off only x0.58; noise-adjusted uplift from 9 past events: x1.59; adjust up slightly for deeper discount but shrink due to recent weak lift and pantry-loading risk.

adjustment.analysis: The 25% off promotion is larger than previous 20% and 10% discounts, and the 30% off event (Aug 2025) had a strong lift. The 2026-06-29 Independence Day event with 20% off and a holiday saw x3.5 lift—this week is similar in context. However, the recent 20% off (2026-07-06) only lifted to x0.58, suggesting weak demand or pantry loading. The noise-adjusted uplift from 9 past promotions is x1.59, but this week’s 25% discount is deeper, so we adjust upward. Still, the recent post-promotion dip (x0.73) and weak lift in the prior 20% off suggest overreaction risk. Shrink toward baseline: x1.59 → x1.45. No other drivers. Spread unchanged.
